description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of different video understanding models as a function of the number of frames. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Frames," is a linear scale ranging from 10 to 60 frames. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", is also a linear scale ranging from 40% to 54%. The plot includes four lines representing different models: "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" is depicted with a blue line and circle markers, "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" with a green line and circle markers, "PLLaVA (DP 8)" with an orange line and square markers, and "PLLaVA (DP 16)" with a red line and square markers. The "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" and "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" lines show a slight increase in accuracy as the number of frames increases, maintaining accuracy between 52% and 54%. In contrast, the "PLLaVA (DP 8)" and "PLLaVA (DP 16)" lines show a decline in accuracy as the number of frames increases, starting from around 44% and dropping to just above 40%.
